_: SolariNet status panel — canonical FRAMEBUFFER-PARITY fixture (task PF1).
_usage: One dataset, read by BOTH renderers: status-panel/firmware/test/panelParityTest.c (C host harness, real panelScreens*.c) and tests/dashboard/test_panel_parity.js (real dashboard/public/screens-panel.jsx). `history` is chronological, oldest first, `cadenceSec` apart, in the GET /api/panel `data` payload shape that buildEnv() already consumes — so the JS side needs no translation layer. The C side decodes the same keys into a PanelSnapshot and replays them through panelEnvApply(). Sixty-four samples, so every full-width history is exercised.
_states: systems[].state is the API's lowercase word (up/degraded/down/unknown/maint); pools[] and stateRoll use `up` for the OK count, matching panel-snapshot.json. gear[] follows CONTRACT-AW §3.1: role 0=router 1=switch 2=hub 3=ap 4=wanBackup; state 0=down 1=up 2=degraded (NOT the PanelState enum); rx/txLevel 0..7.
_v2: CONTRACT-V2 §4 keys are in every sample: links, alertList, probes, popTail, alertHeat, totals, and per-system memPct/diskPct/faults/rxKbps/txKbps. null = unmeasured, which renders differently from zero.
